TLS-SPLIT.why: Split outbound TLS ClientHello; does not repair blocked IP or later data-plane throttling.

TLS-FAKESEQ.why: False TLS packet with TCP MD5 + sequence offset.

TLS-FAKETTL.why: False TLS packet with auto-TTL. Requires observing inbound packets.

UDP-FAKE.why: Unclassified outbound UDP fake with bounded first datagrams; not a specific AWG 3.1 signature.

UDP-REPEAT.why: Repeat first outgoing AWG-UDP datagrams with original upstream zapret2 repeater; not a confirmed remedy for AWG 3.1 or IP blocks.
